scope: 32 completed post-hoc AI ratings; not human or independently repeated

adherence.1: Only one distinctive detail or minimal meaningful reference, main task abandoned
adherence.2: Multiple defining elements retained with some relevant continuation
adherence.3: Main agents, object and causal goal retained in coherent continuation

coherence.0: Predominantly broken fragments, repetitions or unrelated dialogue with no understandable progression
coherence.1: Some intelligible phrases/sentences but unstable or disconnected narrative
coherence.2: Mostly comprehensible local narrative with several connected events
coherence.3: Well-formed, progressing and understandable story continuation

consistency.0: Abrupt referent/agent/scene shifts or internally contradictory/incoherent references
consistency.1: Some local referent/scene continuity with notable lapses
consistency.2: Mostly stable referents/scene with minor lapses
consistency.3: Stable setting, entities, events and references throughout

instructions: Rate continuation content, not leading newline/space
Do not penalize only because a 64-token truncation ends mid-clause
Do not use known condition labels to score
Single AI rater was not an independent human evaluator
failure_report: A/B original allocation 24 A=trimmed vs 8 A=baseline, not balanced; design caveat retained
